items.exampleEn: I followed the recipe exactly, but the cake still did not turn out right.
items.exampleZh: 我完全照著食譜做，蛋糕還是失敗了。

items.exampleEn: The villagers showed us great hospitality and invited us for dinner.
items.exampleZh: 村民熱情款待我們，還邀我們吃晚餐。

items.exampleEn: This cocktail is made with orange juice and lemon.
items.exampleZh: 這杯雞尾酒是用柳橙汁和檸檬調成的。

items.exampleEn: Working as a bartender, he often finishes work at three a.m.
items.exampleZh: 他當調酒師，常常凌晨三點才下班。

items.exampleEn: My aunt met my uncle at a nightclub thirty years ago.
items.exampleZh: 我阿姨三十年前在一家夜店認識了我姨丈。

items.exampleEn: The brewery offers tours where visitors can see how beer is made.
items.exampleZh: 那家啤酒廠提供導覽，讓參觀者看看啤酒是怎麼釀的。

items.exampleEn: The school's catering staff prepare eight hundred lunches a day.
items.exampleZh: 學校的餐飲人員每天準備八百份午餐。

items.sentenceEn: Many hospitality workers have to work on holidays.
items.sentenceZh: 很多餐旅業的工作人員假日都得上班。

items.audioEn: The catering company will bring lunch for fifty people to the meeting room at noon.
items.audioZh: 外燴公司中午會送五十人份的午餐到會議室。
items.questionZh: 外燴公司中午會做什麼？
options: Deliver food for a large group
Set up a coffee bar in the meeting room

items.sentenceEn: The bartender has worked at this hotel for twenty years.
items.sentenceZh: 那位調酒師已經在這家飯店工作了二十年。

items.sentenceEn: This recipe for pineapple cake uses very little sugar.
items.sentenceZh: 這份鳳梨酥食譜只用很少的糖。

items.stemEn: The concert hall has its own ____ service for parties after the show.
items.stemZh: 那座音樂廳有自己的外燴服務，供演出後的派對使用。

items.stemEn: She studied ____ management and now runs a hotel by the sea.
items.stemZh: 她讀的是餐旅管理，現在在海邊經營一家飯店。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my cousin held her wedding party at an old brewery that has been turned into a restaurant. The owners are famous for their hospitality: every guest was welcomed at the door with a smile. A catering team cooked dishes from my grandmother's recipes, which my cousin had sent them a month before. Near the windows, a young bartender made colorful cocktails, and he also had fruit drinks for the children. After dinner, some of my cousin's friends wanted to go to a nightclub, but most guests stayed and danced in the garden. The restaurant gets its vegetables from a local supplier, so everything tasted fresh.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我的表親在一座改建成餐廳的老釀酒廠舉辦婚宴。老闆們以熱情款待聞名：每位賓客一到門口都受到笑臉迎接。外燴團隊照著我奶奶的食譜做菜，那些食譜是我表親一個月前寄給他們的。窗邊有一位年輕的調酒師調出繽紛的雞尾酒，也為孩子們準備了果汁飲料。晚餐後，我的表親有些朋友想去夜店，但大部分賓客都留下來在花園裡跳舞。這家餐廳向當地的供應商購買蔬菜，所以每樣東西都很新鮮。

questions.questionZh: 外燴團隊做的菜有什麼特別？
晚餐後大部分賓客做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 你可以把這道湯的食譜寄給我嗎？
referenceEn: Could you send me the recipe for this soup?
Can you send me this soup's recipe?
rubricZh: recipe 的用法，例如 the recipe for this soup 等
請求句（例如 Could you…?、Can you…? 等）

items.promptZh: 這家釀酒廠僱用了村裡大約一半的人。
referenceEn: This brewery employs about half of the people in the village.
About half of the people in the village work at this brewery.
rubricZh: 「釀酒廠」可寫，例如 brewery 等
「僱用了村裡大約一半的人」可寫，例如 employs about half of…、half of the people … work at 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 employs、employed 等）
